title: ArcCivs 0.1.88 forestry and navigation repair
assumptions: The modeled population is one affected level-1 forester/owner in each low/base/high scenario (participants 1/1/1); it is not the whole network.

The supplied baseline records zero completed tree outputs in affected deadlocked stands. The bounded active-0.1.87 observation was2026-10-25 19:20..19:44UTC; zero is not extrapolated to a per-day rate. Uncounted seed costs for any incomplete pre-change cycles are not estimated.
The after scenarios assume 6/24/72 completed replanted real-tree plots per owner-day at 0.25/1/4 active hours. These are explicit sensitivities, not telemetry, a guaranteed rate, or a hard cap.

At mill level 1, each completed real-tree plot retains the nominal 4 abstract WOOD output and 1 abstract WOOD seed-plot debit. The sensitivity assumes one recurring seed debit per completed replacement plot and excludes initial grove stock and unfinished work. Partial work or planting alone yields zero WOOD.

Mill levels 2 and 3 retain their nominal 8 and 12 abstract WOOD per completed replanted real tree. The calculator isolates the affected level-1 cohort; a healthy isolated stand is unchanged before and after and is not added as a second population.

Auto abstract WOOD is not a physical log payout. Physical towns keep native tree log drops and the existing sapling debit. The safe ownership rule for touching crowns retains foreign, shared, and out-of-bounds leaves for native decay while isolated owned crowns remain collectible. Leaf loot location or timing may differ; this assessment promises no extra item quantity.

Physical item quantities, current SELL quotes, contract acceptance, and restored production throughput are not known here. No item is converted into money. EconomyShopGUI SELL remains current; the planned SELL-off and contract transition is future state.

Direct Vault, tokens, and player XP flows remain zero in separate units. No price, payout, cap, production-duration, or boost changes. The 2,048-cell mutation bound remains; unavailable/protected/oversized trunks still reject, while unavailable/shared/escaping foliage is preserved unmodified. Recovered availability may remove false-yield replans, but its indirect throughput effect is unmeasured.

flows.basis: L1 keeps its existing 4 abstract WOOD per completed replanted real tree. The supplied affected-stand baseline has zero completed events; after counts are hypothetical sensitivities, not telemetry.
One abstract WOOD per modeled completed replacement plot, paired with the same-cycle completed-tree sensitivity. No unobserved partial planting count is invented.
